newsitem.title: USA: American Stone not buying Canada quarry.
newsitem.headline: American Stone not buying Canada quarry.

text.p: American Stone Industries Inc said on Friday it allowed to expire, a previously announced letter of intent to acquire a small Canadian marble quarry, as its board had decided to focus on maximizing existing assets.

In June, American Stone announced its intent to buy Stocklosar Marble Quarries Ltd in Ontario, which has access to land containing marble quarries. Stocklosar also owns and operates one crushing and hammer mill and owns another crushing mill, the company said.

Ontario-based American Stone Industries, through its American Stone Corp subsidiary in Ohio, owns and operates more than 900 acres of land with sandstone reserves estimated at 29 million tons, along with extensive stone processing equipment.
